# ChipGroup

A compact horizontal group of tag chips that collapses overflow into a clickable `+N` chip with a popup of the remaining items.

```ts
import { ChipGroup } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Basic Usage

Pass `items` and the group renders one chip per entry, separated by a 4px gap. Each item needs a unique `id` and a plain-text `label`; `content` is optional for richer chip bodies.

```tsx preview
import { ChipGroup } from '@wfm/ui-components';

export default function Demo() {
  const items = [
    { id: '1', label: 'Sales' },
    { id: '2', label: 'Support' },
  ];
  return <ChipGroup items={items} data-qa="basic-chip-group" />;
}
```

## Overflow with `maxVisible`

`maxVisible` (default `2`) caps how many chips render inline. Anything beyond that collapses into a `+N` overflow chip — clicking it opens a popup that lists the full set.

```tsx preview
import { ChipGroup } from '@wfm/ui-components';

export default function Demo() {
  const items = [
    { id: '1', label: 'Sales' },
    { id: '2', label: 'Support' },
    { id: '3', label: 'Engineering' },
    { id: '4', label: 'Design' },
    { id: '5', label: 'Operations' },
  ];
  return (
    <ChipGroup items={items} maxVisible={2} data-qa="overflow-chip-group" />
  );
}
```

## Popup Content — `all` vs `hidden`

`popupContent` controls what appears inside the overflow popup. `'all'` (default) lists every chip so users can re-scan the entire set; `'hidden'` lists only the chips that did not fit inline.

```tsx preview
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import { Typography, ChipGroup } from '@wfm/ui-components';

export default function Demo() {
  const items = [
    { id: '1', label: 'Sales' },
    { id: '2', label: 'Support' },
    { id: '3', label: 'Engineering' },
    { id: '4', label: 'Design' },
  ];
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap="4">
      <Flex direction="column" gap="2">
        <Typography variant="caption">popupContent="all" (default)</Typography>
        <ChipGroup
          items={items}
          maxVisible={2}
          popupContent="all"
          data-qa="popup-all"
        />
      </Flex>
      <Flex direction="column" gap="2">
        <Typography variant="caption">popupContent="hidden"</Typography>
        <ChipGroup
          items={items}
          maxVisible={2}
          popupContent="hidden"
          data-qa="popup-hidden"
        />
      </Flex>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Color Variants

`color` switches the Cobalt tag palette: `default` for neutral metadata, `info` for informational emphasis, `theme` for primary brand emphasis.

```tsx preview
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import { ChipGroup } from '@wfm/ui-components';

export default function Demo() {
  const items = [
    { id: '1', label: 'Alpha' },
    { id: '2', label: 'Beta' },
  ];
  return (
    <Flex gap="4" alignY="center">
      <ChipGroup items={items} color="default" data-qa="color-default" />
      <ChipGroup items={items} color="info" data-qa="color-info" />
      <ChipGroup items={items} color="theme" data-qa="color-theme" />
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Size Variants

`size` mirrors the Cobalt `Tag` scale. Use `tiny` inside dense rows or table cells, `small` (default) for general metadata, and `medium` when chips share a row with body text.

```tsx preview
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import { ChipGroup } from '@wfm/ui-components';

export default function Demo() {
  const items = [
    { id: '1', label: 'Alpha' },
    { id: '2', label: 'Beta' },
    { id: '3', label: 'Gamma' },
  ];
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap="3">
      <ChipGroup items={items} size="tiny" maxVisible={2} data-qa="size-tiny" />
      <ChipGroup
        items={items}
        size="small"
        maxVisible={2}
        data-qa="size-small"
      />
      <ChipGroup
        items={items}
        size="medium"
        maxVisible={2}
        data-qa="size-medium"
      />
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Long Labels — `maxChipWidth`

Inline chips truncate with ellipsis once they exceed `maxChipWidth` (default `120`). The full label is preserved in the chip's native `title` tooltip and inside the overflow popup.

```tsx preview
import { ChipGroup } from '@wfm/ui-components';

export default function Demo() {
  const items = [
    { id: '1', label: 'Customer Success Operations' },
    { id: '2', label: 'Workforce Management Optimization' },
    { id: '3', label: 'Quality Assurance and Coaching' },
  ];
  return (
    <ChipGroup
      items={items}
      maxVisible={2}
      maxChipWidth={140}
      data-qa="long-label-chip-group"
    />
  );
}
```

## Custom Chip Content

Provide `content` on an item to render anything richer than plain text — for example an icon next to the label. `label` is still required as the truncation tooltip and popup fallback.

```tsx preview
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Icon from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-icon';
import { ChipGroup } from '@wfm/ui-components';

export default function Demo() {
  const items = [
    {
      id: '1',
      label: 'Verified',
      content: (
        <Flex alignY="center" gap="1">
          <Icon iconName="check-circle-fill" size="tiny" />
          Verified
        </Flex>
      ),
    },
    { id: '2', label: 'Draft' },
    { id: '3', label: 'Archived' },
  ];
  return (
    <ChipGroup
      items={items}
      maxVisible={2}
      data-qa="custom-content-chip-group"
    />
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop             | Type                             | Default          | Description                                                                       |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items`          | `ChipGroupItem[]`                | —                | Chips to render, in order.                                                        |
| `maxVisible`     | `number`                         | `2`              | Maximum chips shown inline before collapsing into a `+N` overflow chip.           |
| `color`          | `'default' \| 'info' \| 'theme'` | `'default'`      | Visual emphasis of the chips.                                                     |
| `size`           | `'tiny' \| 'small' \| 'medium'`  | `'small'`        | Chip size.                                                                        |
| `maxChipWidth`   | `number \| string`               | `120`            | Maximum width of an individual inline chip; longer labels truncate with ellipsis. |
| `popupContent`   | `'all' \| 'hidden'`              | `'all'`          | What the overflow popup lists — every chip, or only the ones that did not fit.    |
| `data-qa`        | `string`                         | —                | QA selector. Suffixes `-{id}`, `-overflow`, `-popup`, `-popup-{id}` are derived.  |
| `data-component` | `string`                         | `'WFMChipGroup'` | Component identifier.                                                             |

### `ChipGroupItem`

| Field     | Type        | Required | Description                                                                                      |
| --------- | ----------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`      | `string`    | yes      | Unique identifier — used as React `key` and inside derived `data-qa` selectors.                  |
| `label`   | `string`    | yes      | Plain-text label. Used as the chip body fallback, the truncation `title`, and the popup display. |
| `content` | `ReactNode` | no       | Optional custom chip body (e.g. icon + label). Falls back to `label` when omitted.               |
